# A Jew — Breslov Torah Library — Full Content Index

> The largest online Breslov Torah library. 226+ sacred Jewish texts, 25,000+ pages in Hebrew with English translations. Free and open to all.

**URL:** https://ajew.org
**Tagline:** Breslov Torah Treasury — Free & Open to All
**Contact:** naanaach@gmail.com

## Text Library (reader subpages)

### Breslov Primary Texts
- Likutay Moharan: https://ajew.org/reader/likutay-moharan/
- Likutay Moharan Tinyana: https://ajew.org/reader/likutay-moharan-tinyana/
- Likutay Halachos: https://ajew.org/reader/likutay-halachos/ (multiple volumes - Orach Chaim, Yoreh Deah, Even HaEzer, Choshen Mishpat)
- Likutay Tefilos: https://ajew.org/reader/likutay-tefilos/ (Parts 1-2)
- Sipuray Ma'asiyos: https://ajew.org/reader/sipuray-maasiyos/
- Sefer HaMidos (Aleph-Beis): https://ajew.org/reader/sefer-hamidos/

### Tanach (Complete)
- Bereishis, Shemos, Vayikra, Bamidbar, Devarim
- Yehoshua, Shoftim, Shmuel A, Shmuel B, Melachim A, Melachim B
- Yeshayahu, Yirmiyahu, Yechezkel
- Hoshea, Yoel, Amos, Ovadya, Yonah, Michah, Nachum, Chavakuk, Tzefanya, Chagai, Zecharya, Malachi
- Tehillim, Mishlei, Iyov
- Shir HaShirim, Rus, Eicha, Koheles, Esther
- Daniel, Ezra, Nechemia, Divrei HaYamim A, Divrei HaYamim B
- All at: https://ajew.org/reader/tanach-[book]/
